mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, risk aversion intensifies, causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns do not decline significantly (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.5% in the subsequent 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and demand for goods (RSAFS) indicates robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises 5% and RSAFS rises 10% in a month
failure_condition: The joint effect of GDPC1 and RSAFS growth is not statistically significant in predicting positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (e.g., rising FEDFUNDS), elevated discount rates reduce equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns do not decline (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS indicate a tightening cycle over 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the supply index (INDPRO) below 102 suggests weak production capacity, prompting demand-driven equity rallies and positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to be positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 102 in the following 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in employment (PAYEMS) and contraction in unemployment (UNRATE) reflects a strong labor market, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 2% and UNRATE decreases by 0.1pp in a month
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE movements does not predict significant positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 4%) signal a robust labor market, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE remains below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in GDP (GDPC1) above 18,000 indicates robust demand, prompting equity price adjustments that result in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns do not rise (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 18,000 in the subsequent 20 trading days.
